active_parameter_count_definition: materialized shared parameters plus top-2 complete expert matrices; generated QK latent count is reported separately and is never substituted for materialized active parameters
candidate_scope: Composition discriminator: reuse the accepted QK64 bilateral-Cayley plus output-gain map while keeping V, attention c_proj, and every complete sparse-MoE expert c_fc/c_proj dense and Muon-trained.
experiment_role: 124M generated-QK plus dense-complete-expert sparse-MoE composition discriminator; no generated expert and no residual-write compression
mfu_measurement_protocol: foreground exact CUDA BF16 training-path preflight with one warmup and eight timed updates; fold bilateral QK Cayley charts into cached QK weights, issue one packed QK+V projection, execute only real routed expert rows without max-capacity zero padding, and include BlockFHT pullback, per-expert Muon, dense V/O Muon, router AdamW, and router auxiliary losses
monitoring_policy: foreground-poll the sub-five-minute MFU preflight; the scientific run is expected under two hours and receives one idempotent terminal-or-error @Codex callback only
prelaunch_provenance_requirements: record Git commit, entrypoint, literal command, config SHA-256, source hashes, dataset manifest, fixed-evaluation identity, exact materialized/trainable/state counts, MFU certificate, and terminal log/status/checkpoint hashes
selection_endpoint: terminal fixed-evaluation validation CE; compare to the sealed dense-complete-expert MoE control in the same gauge
